fts_no_filters:
WITH base AS (
            SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.content,
                   ts_rank(c.tsv, %s::tsquery) AS score
            FROM chunks c
            
            WHERE c.tsv @@ %s::tsquery
        ),
        ranked AS (
            SELECT id, document_id, chunk_index, content, score,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY document_id ORDER BY score DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM base
        )
        SELECT id, document_id, chunk_index, content, score
        FROM ranked
        WHERE rn <= 3
        ORDER BY score DESC
        LIMIT 50
fts_source_kind:
WITH base AS (
            SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.content,
                   ts_rank(c.tsv, %s::tsquery) AS score
            FROM chunks c
            JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id
            WHERE c.tsv @@ %s::tsquery AND TRUE AND d.source_id IN (SELECT id FROM sources WHERE kind=%s)
        ),
        ranked AS (
            SELECT id, document_id, chunk_index, content, score,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY document_id ORDER BY score DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM base
        )
        SELECT id, document_id, chunk_index, content, score
        FROM ranked
        WHERE rn <= 3
        ORDER BY score DESC
        LIMIT 50
vector_no_filters:
SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.content,
                   1 - (c.embedding <=> %s::vector) AS score
            FROM chunks c
            
            WHERE 1 - (c.embedding <=> %s::vector) >= %s
            ORDER BY c.embedding <=> %s::vector
            LIMIT 50
